title: colysis macrophylla var. pedunculata
intro: Colysis macrophylla var. pedunculata, commonly known as Colysis, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae, native to tropical Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Colysis include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Colysis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
